- Suggested attendees: engineering lead, ML infra/ops, security reviewer (if you want them on the call).
- What we need from you pre-call: a small sample of typical request/response sizes, and a rough QPS profile during peak.

Availability from our side (all in PT):
- Option A: Thu 8/27, 10:00–11:30
- Option B: Fri 8/28, 13:00–14:30
- Option C: Mon 8/31, 09:00–10:30

If you can confirm which option works (or propose two slots), I'll loop in Marissa (ML infra) and Ben (SE) and share a short precall checklist and agenda.

Thanks —

Great — we’ll lock Fri 8/28 13:00–14:30 PT for the 75-minute deep dive. Marissa (ML infra) will drive the technical agenda.

Proposed agenda (high-level):
1) 5m intro + objectives (Connor)
2) 15m architecture & workload profile from QuantaHealth (Alex / Samir)
3) 25m serving runtime deep dive (Marissa) — batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs
4) 20m integration/operational constraints (networking/VPC, secrets, audit logs) + Q&A
5) 10m next steps & mutual action items

Precall asks (short):
- 1–2 sample requests + sizes (or a synthetic representative example)
- Peak and off-peak QPS estimates

I’ve attached a short precall checklist and a short note with migration considerations. If Leah or Samir want to add items, please reply-all.
